{{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}}

::: {#exr-elephant-buy-car}
At an input of zero, the osc() function has output zero and a positive slope.

a. What is the smallest input value greater than zero at which osc() has output zero and a positive slope?
`r devoirs::devoirs_set(choices = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), correct=1, n=5, id = "ebc-a-3slc")`

b. What is the smallest input value greater than zero at which osc() has output zero and a *negative* slope?
`r devoirs::devoirs_set(choices = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), correct=0.5, n=5, id = "ebc-b-sc")`

c. Which of these input values gives a *zero* rate of change of osc() with respect to the input?
`r devoirs::devoirs_set(choices = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), correct=0.25, n=5, id = "ebc-c-sc")`


:::
